ORIGIN: ECHO CITY
YEAR: [REDACTED]
FILE STATUS: UNRESOLVED

November 1st.

The temperature hasn't risen above freezing in 317 days.

They still call it autumn.

Nobody remembers why.

The last summer exists only in corrupted photographs. The oceans have stopped reflecting the sky. Snow falls through the ventilation shafts of buildings that were never designed to keep people warm.

The weather satellites went silent in March.

The machines kept recording.

At 04:17, an unidentified figure appeared on the eastern observation platform.

Female. Silver armor. No thermal protection.

She stood beneath the atmospheric vortex for eleven minutes while lightning struck the surrounding towers.

Her body temperature remained unchanged.

When the surveillance system attempted facial recognition, every camera returned the same message:

SUBJECT PRECEDES RECORD.

At 04:28, she looked directly into the storm.

And the storm looked back.

The final transmission contained only six words:

“Winter was never supposed to end.”

No further contact was established.

The snow continues.

END TRANSMISSION // SIGNAL LOST
